criteria.bent_or_misaligned: centerline displacement failed; human review is required because registration can cause the same signal
criteria.broken: continuous support failed or a large unsupported gap remained, excluding missing criterion
criteria.healthy: existing metrology decision was clearly inside declared tolerances
criteria.missing: axial_coverage and unsupported_gap failed, with observed coverage < 0.35
criteria.thick: p90 radial deviation exceeded effective tolerance and signed deviation was positive
criteria.thin: p90 radial deviation exceeded effective tolerance and signed deviation was negative
criteria.uncertain: invalid, incomplete, conflicting, or near-threshold evidence

limitations: subtypes are evidence classifications, not manually confirmed ground truth
missing versus broken uses a policy boundary at 35 percent axial support
thin/thick depends on calibrated expected radius and registration uncertainty
bent and registration offset cannot be separated automatically from this report alone
